Measured flow 1.15 L/s suggests reduced delivery, but pump stop test indicates outflow consistent with demand+leak, requiring leak to explain zero trend.

diagnosis.summary: E1: BAL-101 shows near-zero level trend (-0.04 mm/min) while pump on and demand 1.0 L/s predicts +6 mm/min rise. E2: Measured inlet flow 1.15 L/s (±0.03) slightly below rated 1.2 L/s. E3: Dip-tape level 1.55 m vs LT-101 1.56 m indicates offset but not static. E4: Pump stop test yields level fall -34 mm in 60 s → outflow ~1.27 L/s, exceeding demand (~1.0 L/s) implying leak ~0.27 L/s. Together these support tank_leak and weaken other hypotheses.
